concepts.def: Jobs: der Arzt/die Ärztin (doctor), der Lehrer/die Lehrerin (teacher), der Ingenieur (engineer), der Anwalt (lawyer).
Most German jobs have masculine + feminine forms: Lehrer / Lehrerin, Arzt / Ärztin, Student / Studentin (-in suffix).
'Ich möchte...werden' (I would like to become...), 'Ich werde...studieren' (I will study...).
German training: die Ausbildung (apprenticeship), das Praktikum (work placement), die Lehre (apprenticeship).
Workplace: der Arbeitsplatz, der Chef (boss), das Gehalt (salary), das Vorstellungsgespräch (job interview).
Adjective endings depend on case + article: 'ein guter Job' (nom), 'einen guten Job' (acc), 'einem guten Job' (dat).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 5: Studying and My Future — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 5: Studying and My Future brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 5: Studying and My Future.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence means 'I want to become a doctor' (female speaker)?
options: Ich möchte Ärztin werden.
Ich möchte ein Arzt werden.
Ich möchte Arzt werden bin.
Ich werde möchte Arzt sein.
a work placement
a salary
a boss
a CV

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I will drink coffee tomorrow' in German?
options: Ich werde morgen Kaffee trinken.
Ich will Kaffee morgen trinken.
Ich gehe Kaffee trinken morgen.
Feminine.

mcqs.q: What is the gender of 'Lieblingsfach' (favourite subject)?
options: Ich gehe Kaffee trinken morgen.
Masculine (because der Lieblings...).
Neuter (das Fach).
Feminine.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between 'ich will' and 'ich möchte'?
options: Ich will = I want (strong, direct); ich möchte = I would like (polite).
Ich will is future tense.
Feminine.
They mean the same thing.
